scripts.build: tsc -p ../core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p ../shared/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && shx mkdir -p dist/db/postgres/migrations && shx cp src/db/postgres/migrations/*.sql dist/db/postgres/migrations/
scripts.test: tsc -p ../core/tsconfig.build.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DB_BACKEND= FREEBOARD_POSTGRES_URL= SECURITY_LIMITER_BACKEND=memory DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/freeboard tsc -p ../shared/tsconfig.build.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DB_BACKEND= FREEBOARD_POSTGRES_URL= SECURITY_LIMITER_BACKEND=memory DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/freeboard tsx --test --test-concurrency=1
scripts.test:ci: tsc -p ../core/tsconfig.build.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DB_BACKEND= FREEBOARD_POSTGRES_URL= SECURITY_LIMITER_BACKEND=memory DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/freeboard tsc -p ../shared/tsconfig.build.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DB_BACKEND= FREEBOARD_POSTGRES_URL= SECURITY_LIMITER_BACKEND=memory DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/freeboard tsx --test --test-concurrency=1
